description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Loader' that displays a loading animation with animated circles, including setup of properties, state, hooks, and methods for the component.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays an animated loader consisting of circles with fading alpha transition.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates a repeating interval that toggles the 'alpha' state between 0 and 1 to create a fade-in and fade-out transition for the circles.
